name: Ample Families Are Closed Under Coordinate-Block Replacement
statement: Replacing any coordinate of an ample family by any nonempty block produces an ample family. The shadow, cardinality, VC dimension, and signed minimal nonfaces obey the exact formulas in the coordinate-block replacement theorem.
proof: Every proper new-coordinate support is carried by the old contraction, while a support using the whole new block is carried by the old reduction. Their disjoint support count equals the number of constructed words, so Sandwich equality proves ampleness.
